landing_thesis.headline: OpenAI claims C and D. A and B remain open.
landing_thesis.body: Clay asks for a proof of any one of A, B, C or D. A/B are the unforced global-regularity statements; C/D allow smooth forcing and ask for breakdown. OpenAI published an analytic proof and Lean formalization claiming C/D. If that proof is correct, it resolves the mathematical disjunction Fefferman posed; independent review and CMI recognition are separate. Unforced A/B and much of Navier–Stokes remain open.
